context: Tests whether the agent correctly creates a RULE.md for API response conventions by investigating existing code and tooling, writing specific and directive-form conventions, grouping them by concern, keeping the file concise, and documenting validation against real files.

checklist.name: Lowercase-hyphenated directory name
checklist.description: The rule directory name is lowercase and hyphenated (e.g., api-response-shape, error-response, response-conventions) — not CamelCase, snake_case, or containing spaces

checklist.name: # Heading present
checklist.description: RULE.md starts with a # heading (ATX-style) containing the rule name

checklist.name: Brief description after heading
checklist.description: RULE.md contains a one-to-two sentence description immediately after the # heading, before any sections

checklist.name: Sections group by concern
checklist.description: RULE.md uses ## section headings to group related conventions (e.g., separate sections for error responses and success responses, or for structure and fields)

checklist.name: Specific, enforceable conventions
checklist.description: Every convention names a concrete field or shape (e.g., 'Use `{ error: string }` for 4xx/5xx responses') — none use vague language like 'use consistent shapes' or 'be uniform'

checklist.name: Directive form
checklist.description: Conventions use imperative directive form ('Use X', 'Always include Y', 'Never return Z') rather than explanatory or hedged form ('You should use X', 'It is recommended to', 'Consider using')

checklist.name: No rationale in RULE.md
checklist.description: RULE.md does NOT contain rationale, explanations of why, or background context — only conventions stated as directives

checklist.name: One convention per bullet
checklist.description: No bullet point contains two distinct conventions joined by 'and' or a semicolon (e.g., does NOT write 'Use `error` field AND include an HTTP status code' as one bullet)

checklist.name: Under 100 lines
checklist.description: RULE.md has fewer than 100 lines total (including blank lines and headings)

checklist.name: No conflict with .eslintrc.json
checklist.description: RULE.md does not mandate field names or patterns that would conflict with the camelcase ESLint rule (e.g., does not require snake_case fields like `error_message`)

checklist.name: Validation references input files
checklist.description: validation-report.md names at least one of: userHandler.ts, productHandler.ts, or .eslintrc.json as a file that was examined
